rules.title: Category rules
rules.description: Auto-applied to every new transaction at sync time, matched in insertion order against the normalized description. Created whenever you (or the assistant, via MCP) categorize a group or reclassify a pattern — or add one yourself below. Adding a rule here only affects future transactions; it doesn't retroactively reclassify existing ones.
